soldier: Head reddish brown, the anterior margin of the head together with the flange over the antennal socket reddish brown, labrum brownish yellow, mandibles almost black. The antennae themselves pale yellow; from segment 3 onwards the posterior half of each segment turns pale brown to brown, so that the boundaries between segments are distinct. Pronotum pale reddish brown, femora pale yellow, tibiae and tarsi pale yellowish brown, abdomen pale yellowish white. The head is rather densely haired, several long setae around the fontanelle area, the clypeal hairs sparse, the anterior margin of the labrum with 12 hairs in all, the dorsum of the pronotum likewise rather densely haired.
